description: This Java source file defines the class 'EntityDataServices' which provides various data import/export services, database indexing and key rebuilding, encryption key management, and record processing functionalities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for importing/exporting delimited files, rebuilding indexes, unwrapping byte wrappers, and re-encrypting private keys and fields.

classes.name: EntityDataServices
classes.description: Provides a suite of data import/export and database maintenance services for entities in the OFBiz framework. Supports operations such as importing delimited files, rebuilding indexes and keys, decrypting/encrypting private keys, and updating byte data.

methods.name: exportDelimitedToDirectory
methods.description: Stub method indicating exporting entity data to directory is not yet implemented.

methods.name: importDelimitedFromDirectory
methods.description: Imports entity data from files within a specified directory, processing all listed files.

methods.name: importDelimitedFile
methods.description: Imports data from a specific delimited file into the database, creating or updating records.

methods.name: getFileList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entity data files from a directory, either from a FILELIST.txt or by directory scan.

methods.name: readEntityHeader
methods.description: Reads and returns the header row (field names) for a data file, optionally from a header file.

methods.name: readEntityFile
methods.description: Processes a data file, reading each line to create or update entity records in the database.

methods.name: makeGenericValue
methods.description: Creates a GenericValue object from header field names and corresponding data fields.

methods.name: rebuildAllIndexesAndKeys
methods.description: Removes and recreates indexes, keys, and constraints for all entities in a specified group, optionally fixing column sizes.

methods.name: unwrapByteWrappers
methods.description: Iterates over records of specified entity and unwraps byte array fields, storing the updated records.

methods.name: reencryptPrivateKeys
methods.description: Decrypts and re-encrypts private key records with new encryption keys, updating stored values.

methods.name: reencryptFields
methods.description: Re-encrypts encrypted fields across entity records within a group, based on encryption settings.
